subject: Television & Streaming
title: Hwang Dong-hyuk and Global Korean TV
description: A 60-second lesson on Hwang Dong-hyuk and Global Korean TV.

hook.text: Hwang Dong-hyuk spent a decade trying to get Squid Game made. Every Korean studio rejected it as too violent.

buildup.text: Netflix gave him the budget and global platform no Korean network could offer.

discovery.text: Squid Game became the most-watched Netflix series ever—142 million households in its first 28 days.

twist.text: The show's critique of capitalism resonated globally.

climax.text: Hwang proved that a Korean creator's vision could dominate global culture—without compromising for Western audiences.

punchline.text: A rejected script became the biggest show on Earth.

quiz.question: How many households watched Squid Game in its first 28 days?
